data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $121m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: adverse developments on prior year claims estimates of $121 million. The most significant contributors were London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m) and Workers' Compensation ($18m) accounts due to unfavourable claims experience.

data.standardized_narrative: In 2017, Syndicate 2003 experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves totaling $121.0 million, representing 2.92% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by unfavorable claims experience in London Wholesale Property ($58m), Energy ($32m), and US Workers' Compensation ($18m) accounts. The syndicate also reported significant losses from 2017 catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, the Mexico earthquake, and California Wildfires, which collectively resulted in a net loss of $290 million after reinsurance.
